description: The call graph's edge fact is derived from the lowered body alone, so a call through a value (LoweredTail::ClosureCall) contributes no edge even after AnalyzeActivation has resolved its targets (CallSiteTargets per activation). Witness: loop(f, n) calling f.(f, n - 1), entered as loop(&loop/2, 3), is recursion the graph never sees; Recursive(loop) is false and the transport cut cannot find the owner. Make the edge fact cumulative: the body's contribution (direct calls and constructions) plus, from every analysis of one of f's activations, the value-call targets it resolved, using the existing contribution discipline (accumulate on extend, replace on conclude, retraction frontier). Reachability and the component read that one fact. Recursive may flip false to true mid-compile when a value call resolves: Recursive is not cumulative, so the flip is a ground shift that rebases every caller through the Recursive(callee) read it holds, and the old keys lose their contributors and retract (assert on Activation/ActivationInputs, not ReturnType, which lingers as fz-kdt.69 debt). Proof: the witness keys as recursive on both doors, artifacts byte-identical under permuted submission orders, no orphan activation keys after the flip, corpus canon compared against base, job-start census on json_roundtrip compared before and after (the transport cut's settled read of the edge fact now covers every analysis in the cone; a stall there is the named risk). Third commit of fz-kdt.98.
title: One cumulative call-graph edge fact: body edges plus the value-call targets each analysis resolves
